enGB: You've been plagued by spirits for as long as you can remember. Because of this, you have a deeper connection with the Medium spirits that can be channeled. Increase the medium's spirit bonus by 1/6 for every level you take in the medium class.
zhCN: 从记事起，英灵就一直缠绕着你。因此，你与可通过降灵引导的英灵有着更深的联系。每获得一个通灵者职业等级，你的英灵同调提高1/6。

enGB: You can channel additional different spirits using your channel spirit abilities. The second spirit adds 1 influence, the third 2, the fourth 3, and so on, to your shared accumulated influence. Only spirits available to your class can be chosen. Each grants powers appropriate to your level. While you formally channel N spirits, divide the magnitude of each numerical influence penalty by N, rounding down; two spirits halve it, three reduce it to one-third. This also reduces the usual -2 initiative penalty. Positive bonuses and the Marshal's forced defensive fighting are unchanged. Temporary Trance spirits and powers granted by Astral Beacon do not increase N. Overlapping spirit bonuses use the highest value. Archmage and Hierophant share the Medium spellbook and daily casts. Additional spirits do not refill spent spell slots. Rest ends all channeling.
zhCN: 你可以继续使用降灵能力，引导尚未降灵的其他英灵。第二位额外积累1点共鸣，第三位2点，第四位3点，依此类推；所有英灵共用已积累共鸣与上限。只能选择本职业可降灵的英灵，不能重复。每位英灵按当前等级提供能力。同时正式降灵N位英灵时，各项共鸣数值减值的幅度除以N并向下取整：两位时减半，三位时降至三分之一；原本的先攻−2也按此减轻。正面加值与统帅强制防御式战斗不变。临时入神及星界灯塔仅授予能力的副英灵不计入N。同一属性的英灵同调取最高值。大法师与大祭司共用通灵者本体法术书与施法次数，追加降灵不会补满已用法术位。休息结束所有降灵。

enGB: At Medium level 20, your hardened soul can withstand greater spirit influence. Your influence limit increases by 3, and your spirit surge rolls 2d8 instead of its normal die. This replaces Astral Beacon. The three-point influence penalty threshold is unchanged. The influence limit increase stacks with Mythic Expanded Influence.
zhCN: 通灵者达到20级时，你的灵魂已能承受更强的英灵共鸣。共鸣上限额外提高3点，灵力奔涌改为掷2d8，替代通常的奔涌骰。本能力替代星界灯塔；共鸣达到3点时的惩罚阈值不变。上限加值可与神话共鸣扩容叠加。

enGB: At Medium level 20, choose your capstone: Astral Beacon, Hardened Soul, or an available generic alternate capstone from Tabletop Tweaks. Choose one ability only; selecting an alternative replaces Astral Beacon. This choice is enabled only while Tabletop Tweaks Base and its alternate capstone group are enabled. Existing characters retain their previously acquired capstone; retraining permits a new choice.
zhCN: 通灵者达到20级时，选择一项巅峰能力：星界灯塔、坚韧灵魂，或符合条件的 Tabletop Tweaks 通用替代巅峰能力。只能选择一项，选择替代能力后不再获得星界灯塔。此选择仅在 Tabletop Tweaks Base 及其替代巅峰功能启用时开放。已有角色保留已获得的巅峰能力，重训时可以重新选择。

enGB: Prerequisite: spirit bonus class feature. Choose the legend of one spirit. Your spirit bonus increases by 1 for that legend. You can take this feat multiple times, but only once per legend.
zhCN: 先决条件：英灵同调（Spirit Bonus）职业能力。选择一种英灵的职阶（legend）。对于该职阶来说，你的英灵同调（Spirit Bonus）带来的加值增加1点。本专长可以多次选取，但每个职阶只能选择一次。

enGB: When you complete a seance, your allies also gain the effect of your channeled spirit's spirit bonus. The mirrored bonus matches yours exactly, including Spirit Focus increases, and overlapping spirit bonuses from several channeled spirits use the highest value. It updates when you channel additional spirits, switch spirits, or end the seance. The Medium itself does not gain the bonus a second time.
zhCN: 当你完成降灵（Seance）时，你的盟友也获得你的附身英灵的英灵同调（Spirit Bonus）加值效果。镜像的加值与你的完全一致，包括英灵专攻带来的提高；多重降灵时，多个英灵的同调项目取最高值。追加降灵、更换英灵或结束降灵时，盟友的加值同步更新。通灵者自身不会重复获得该加值。
未冕王阿德里尔（传奇勇士）

enGB:
Adriel was born to a royal line but never claimed a throne; a peerless duelist and warlord, he won every war he fought yet died uncrowned. Channeling Adriel uses the Champion tier's spirit bonus, seance boon, influence penalty, intermediate power (Sudden Attack) and greater power (Fleet Charge), but replaces the lesser power with Challenge and the supreme power with Death Curse.
Spirit Bonus: When you channel Adriel, your spirit bonus applies on attack rolls, non-spell damage rolls, Strength checks, Strength-based skill checks, and Fortitude saves.
Seance Boon: You gain a +2 bonus on all non-spell damage rolls.
Influence Penalty: You take a penalty on spell attack rolls and caster level checks, Knowledge (Arcana) and Knowledge (World) checks.
Adriel and the Champion share one tier: you cannot channel both at the same time.
zhCN:
阿德里尔生于王室旁支，却终其一生未曾加冕；他是无可匹敌的决斗者与统帅，赢下了参与的所有战争，最后仍未戴上王冠。降灵阿德里尔时，沿用勇士职介的英灵同调、降灵奖励、共鸣惩罚、中等英灵之力（瞬袭）与高等英灵之力（疾袭），但次级英灵之力由“挑战”取代，至高英灵之力由“恶咒”取代。
英灵同调：降灵阿德里尔时，你的英灵同调加值作用于攻击检定、非法术伤害骰、力量检定、基于力量的技能检定与强韧豁免。
降灵奖励：你的所有非法术伤害骰获得+2加值。
共鸣惩罚：你的法术攻击检定与施法者等级检定、知识（奥术）与知识（世界）检定受到减值。
阿德里尔与勇士同属一个职介：同一时间只能降灵其中之一。

enGB: As Adriel's lesser spirit power, you gain the challenge ability and treat your character level as your cavalier level. Challenging an enemy is a swift action and uses one daily use (uses per day follow the cavalier progression based on character level). While the challenge lasts, you take a -2 penalty to AC against attacks other than the challenged target's, and gain a bonus on damage rolls against the target equal to your character level. Your attacks against the challenged target overcome all of its damage reduction, and you gain a +2 bonus on all saving throws while the challenge lasts.
zhCN: 作为阿德里尔的次级英灵之力，你获得挑战（Challenge）职业能力，并将你的角色等级视为骑将等级。挑战一个敌人是迅捷动作，消耗当日次数（每日次数按角色等级套用骑将的成长）。挑战持续期间：你对来自挑战目标以外的攻击AC-2；对挑战目标的伤害骰获得等于你角色等级的加值；你攻击挑战目标时克服其所有伤害减免；挑战期间你在所有豁免检定上获得+2加值。

enGB: This enemy is the target of Adriel's Challenge: the challenger gains a damage bonus against it and ignores its damage reduction.
zhCN: 该敌人是阿德里尔挑战的目标：挑战者对其伤害获得加值，并无视其伤害减免。

enGB: You have challenged an enemy: -2 AC against attacks other than the challenged target's, a damage bonus against the target equal to your character level, attacks against the target overcome all of its damage reduction, and +2 on all saving throws.
zhCN: 你已挑战一名敌人：对来自挑战目标以外攻击者的AC-2；对挑战目标的伤害骰获得等于你角色等级的加值；攻击挑战目标时克服其所有伤害减免；所有豁免+2。

enGB: As a swift action, challenge an enemy: while the challenge lasts you take a -2 AC penalty against attacks other than the target's, gain a damage bonus against it equal to your character level, your attacks against it overcome all of its damage reduction, and you gain +2 on all saving throws.
zhCN: 迅捷动作，挑战一名敌人：挑战期间你对挑战目标以外的攻击AC-2；对挑战目标的伤害骰获得等于你角色等级的加值；攻击挑战目标时克服其所有伤害减免；所有豁免+2。

enGB: As Adriel's supreme spirit power, while you channel Adriel you can toggle each of five energy types on or off: negative energy, fire, cold, electricity, and acid. At most two of them can be active at once (zero, one or two; negative energy counts like the others). Whenever you hit your challenge target with a weapon, you deal 1d6 extra damage of each active type. Toggling an energy is a free action; using it again turns that energy off. While two are active, turning on a third is refused until you turn one off; nothing is replaced automatically. All energies turn off when the seance ends.
zhCN: 作为阿德里尔的至高英灵之力，降灵阿德里尔时，你可以分别开启或关闭负能量、火焰、寒冷、电击、酸蚀五种能量，但同时最多开启两种（可以是0、1或2种，负能量同样计入）。你以武器命中挑战目标时，每种已开启的能量各造成1d6点额外伤害。开关某种能量是自由动作，再次使用即关闭该能量。已开启两种时，不能再开启第三种，需先关闭其中一种；不会自动替换。降灵结束时所有能量随之关闭。

enGB: You hold your spirits by force rather than by pact. At 1st level, you gain Restless Spirit. You also gain a bonus feat at 2nd, 3rd, 5th, 7th, 9th, and 11th level, chosen from the combined list of fighter bonus feats and wizard bonus feats.
zhCN: 缚灵者以强力而非契约束缚英灵。1 级时获得“永不安宁”职业能力；并在 2、3、5、7、9、11 级各获得一个额外专长，可从战斗专长（战士额外专长）与法师额外专长合并而成的列表中任选其一。

enGB: Your spirits never rest. While you channel a spirit, its influence penalty always applies, no matter how little influence you have accumulated. Your maximum influence increases by 1.
zhCN: 你的英灵永不安宁。只要处于降灵状态，英灵的共鸣惩罚就始终生效，与累计的共鸣值无关。你的共鸣上限 +1。

enGB: Choose one feat from the combined list of fighter bonus feats and wizard bonus feats. You must still meet its prerequisites.
zhCN: 从战斗专长与法师额外专长合并而成的列表中选择一个专长，仍需满足该专长的先决条件。
